scope: Adapter isolado para Appropriate (48539234/CID 4947): ativação somente após compra do oponente fora de Draw Phase; evento de ativação não dispara o efeito; cada compra posterior do oponente gera compra de duas cartas por cópia ativa, para o assento físico ativo da equipe controladora.

cards.name: Appropriate
cards.officialEffect: Activate only when your opponent draws a card(s) outside of either Draw Phase. After that, each time your opponent draws a card(s) outside of either Draw Phase, immediately draw 2 cards.

design.activation: The enabling draw must be by the opposing team and outside Draw Phase. The activation's sequence is stored; that same event is excluded from the subsequent effect.
design.trigger: Each later opponent draw event outside either Draw Phase triggers once per event, not once per card drawn. Each active copy produces its own two-card plan.
design.routing: The draw recipient is the controller team's active physical seat at resolution time; card UID ownership never redirects the draw to a reserve teammate.
design.deckOut: Each copy consumes the next two Deck cards sequentially. If fewer than two remain, the plan reports the partial draw and deck-out; later copies do not plan after a failed draw.
design.negation: Jinzo blocks activation and suppresses Trap effects; source-specific negation is supported. The shared continuousTrapsNegated helper also covers Royal Decree, but Royal Decree is not enabled in the base fixture and is not claimed as directly tested.
design.integrity: Draw events carry stable IDs/sequences, phase, physical drawing seat and exact UIDs already in that seat's private hand. Fingerprinted event replay is idempotent; changed facts are rejected. The adapter returns plans only and never moves cards or mutates inventory.
design.admission: Appropriate is absent from catalog and certification sources. Tests use existing enabled Trap IDs as fixture aliases; no auto-admission or certification occurs.

tests: Activation condition, set-turn restriction, initial-event exclusion
Both teams, active physical seat rotation and owner/controller distinction
Draw Phase exclusion and own-team draw exclusion
Negated/unresolved activation and Jinzo activation block
One/two copies, sequential deck tops and single-event trigger semantics
Source negation, source removal, face-down reset and set-turn epoch
Idempotent activation/draw replay and divergent replay rejection
Private-hand UID, active-seat, ledger and malformed event validation
